notes.title: Register for the FREE playtest, now!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone, thanks for the support!

Playtest for my game "Boiiiing Boiiing" will be open for everyone in a few days. In this playtest you will be able to play in modes (1v1, 2v2 and FFA), on 3 differents maps, with 9 differents characters.

During this time you can share your feedback directly in [url=https://discord.gg/v8Bg8Bvs6s]my discord[/url].
The end of the playtest is planned for the 31th of May. By the end of May, a survey will send to everyone.
Shortly after that a demo will be available to compensate the end of playtest.

During this playtest, don't hesitate to share gameplay online, and to share it with your friend and familly (you can try to play it with remote play together). [b]All language may not be available at first, but language support will be added as soon as possible.[/b] Also, video and audio settings will arrived on the first week of the playtest, with other QOL features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45521011/c6e42ba47e4820eadabc76cc2cbd19fada7d8ba9.png[/img]

While you're waiting for the playtest to start, feel free to watch my gamevlog on the game's 1-year development, out Saturday, here : 
[previewyoutube=rp9PpjMgFDA;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks a lot for playing it,
SLMB
